items.title: Monthly-cycle registry cross-check — London and Middlesex
items.locations: London, Ilderton, Strathroy, Mount Brydges, Ailsa Craig
items.proposed_action: Manually inspect public CPSO family-physician and CNO nurse-practitioner practice-location records; compare with active office list. Independently verify any unlisted address and whether ongoing primary care is offered.
items.note: Official registers do NOT verify patient acceptance. No automated scraping or registry data ingestion.
items.reviewer_note: CPSO advanced search accessible only as interactive form; CNO registry returned HTTP 403. Regional census not completed; manual review remains required.
